document:464.text:
Recorded By: Crankleton
Date: Day 6,324 since Magister Merlin's departure
Status: Normal (Minor risk of malfunction, self-repair disabled)
Maintenance Log: The 6,324th daily maintenance has been completed as instructed. All tower systems are functioning normally.
Special Remark: To make full use of my idle capacity, I have initiated the book organization program (378th cycle). The tower contains a total of 32,600 books (all read). Among them, 9,507 bear Magister Merlin's signature, and 3,100 show fine tears. No changes from the previous cycle.
Entry complete.
document:464.source_cn:
记录者：塔兰肯斯坦
记录日期：自梅林大人离开后的第6324天
运行状态：正常（存在轻度故障风险，已拒绝自检修复）
今日维护记录：今日，我已按照指令，完成第6324次日常维护，塔内系统运转正常。
备注：为了更高效地利用我的待机能力，我启动了全塔书籍整理计划（已重复第378轮），据统计，塔内共藏有书籍32600本（我已将它们悉数阅读完毕），其中，9507本书的扉页处有梅林大人的签名，3100本书已经出现细碎的裂纹，数据统计与上轮无异。
日志记录完毕。
